title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11631)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11631) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11631).

marking_requirements: 7.1 Each gambrel for sheep and goat shall be marked with the following information;
a) Manufacturer's name or trade-mark, if any;
c) Batch or code number; and
7.1.1 The marking shall be done at an appropriate and visible place.
7.1.2 IS/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
